summary: Iter56 — V3Cube TaxiBidding redesign + UserHome cleanup + TopDriversWidget moved to FavoriteDriversPage. Backend new endpoint /api/phase2/taxi-bidding/live-stats validated. All frontend acceptance criteria met. Fixed one minor dev-blocker (stale eslint-disable comment in TaxiBiddingPage.js).
action_items: Optional: avoid using non-existent ESLint rule names in eslint-disable-next-line comments (caused dev overlay to intercept clicks).
critical_code_review_comments: TaxiBiddingPage.js: previously contained `eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/img-redundant-alt` referencing a rule that is not configured in this project's ESLint plugin set. The webpack-dev-server overlay surfaced this as a 'rule not found' error and intercepted ALL pointer events on the page. Fix applied: removed the comment and changed alt to 'Itinéraire'.

phase2.py live-stats: lat/lng default to None, but the bounding-box check is correctly guarded. Acceptance rate uses ALL historical negotiated rides (not last N) — fine for now but might skew over time.
TopDriversWidget returns null when drivers array is empty; ensure /api/drivers/top is seeded so users actually see the widget on FavoriteDriversPage.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/user/TaxiBiddingPage.js (removed stale eslint-disable comment, alt text update)
seed_data_creation: None — created one TEST_ ride via /api/rides during pytest. Live-stats returned 3 online drivers nearby Paris (Jean/Amadou/Sophie demo seed appears already online).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter56 verified: (1) UserHome /home — simulation-panel and top-drivers-widget both REMOVED ✓. Order: header→search→promo-banner-1→Services Taxi ✓. (2) FavoriteDriversPage /favorite-drivers shows empty-state + top-drivers-widget at bottom ✓ (widget renders because /api/drivers/top returns drivers). (3) TaxiBiddingPage /taxi-bidding — initial state shows address-card with pickup-input/dropoff-input/vehicle-{sb,confort,luxe}; offer-fare-sheet hidden ✓. (4) Prefilled URL with pickup=Paris&plat=48.8566&plng=2.3522&dropoff=Lyon&dlat=45.764&dlng=4.835 → route-summary + offer-fare-sheet (with title 'Offrez votre tarif', live-stats-strip showing '3 chauffeurs en ligne', avg-price-banner '493.32 EUR', fare-input prefilled to 468.65=95% of estimate, fare-plus/minus, find-driver-btn, cancel-btn) all visible ✓. (5) find-driver-btn POSTs to /api/rides and navigates to /ride/{id} ✓. (6) UserHome service-taxi-bidding-btn and bid-electrician-btn navigation OK ✓. (7) Backend /api/phase2/taxi-bidding/live-stats returns proper JSON with all 5 keys; works with/without coords; respects custom radius_km. NOTE: test2 user must exist; if not, login will skip pytest and frontend test will see redirect to /login.
rca of the issue: ESLint rule 'jsx-a11y/img-redundant-alt' referenced via eslint-disable-next-line was not in the configured rule set, causing the webpack-dev-server overlay to render and intercept pointer events. Removed the directive and renamed alt text. No business-logic bug.
